Meet Rakka: The Smart Grocery Guardian

The instant food safety scanner that cross-references barcodes and receipts against federal recall feeds, 12 household dietary allergens, and 37 scrutinized chemical additives.

Federal Recall Wire

Direct ingestion of live openFDA and USDA-FSIS food enforcement logs. Pre-caches offline recall records so you can scan with zero signal in store basements.

1-Shot Lot Code Expiration Verifier

Household Allergen Guard

Custom dietary profiles for every family member. Screens Gluten, Dairy, Peanuts, Tree Nuts, Soy, Eggs, Shellfish, Fish, Sesame, Corn, Sulfites, and Yeast.

Zero False Alarms • Context Aware

Additive & Dye Screener

Audits against 37 synthetic petroleum dyes (Red 40, Yellow 5), Titanium Dioxide, California Food Safety Act (AB 418) banned chemicals, and European EFSA warnings.

Our Origins

Huginn & Muninn:
Thought and Memory

In Old Norse lore, the god Odin possessed two sacred ravens—Huginn (representing thought and active perception) and Muninn (representing memory and stored wisdom). Each dawn, they were dispatched across Midgard to scout the unknown, returning at twilight to whisper vital truths in Odin's ear.

At Twin Ravens Digital LLC, we embody this timeless myth. Our software acts as your vigilant scout—gathering real-time safety feeds, remembering your family's dietary vulnerabilities, and alerting you before harm reaches your home.

🛡️ Our Product Principles

01
100% Client-Side Privacy Your family dietary profiles, receipts, and grocery lists remain stored securely on your device. We never sell health profiles to advertisers.
02
Offline-First Architecture Tools must function where users actually need them—including basement supermarkets and rural food marts with zero signal.
03
Objective Regulatory Grounding All safety warnings are verified against primary federal databases (openFDA, USDA-FSIS, EFSA) rather than internet rumors.
